en.name: Hilarius
en.summary: A pope who as a deacon had survived the violent 'Robber Council' of Ephesus and later worked to reassert Chalcedonian orthodoxy.
en.body: Before his own papacy, Hilarius had been Pope Leo's legate at the chaotic 449 Council of Ephesus — later dubbed the 'Robber Council' — where he narrowly escaped violence while opposing the council's condemnation of Chalcedonian teaching on Christ's two natures. As pope, he worked to consolidate the Council of Chalcedon's authority in the West and held Roman synods reinforcing church discipline and metropolitan jurisdiction in Gaul and Spain.
